Record Class TagSighting

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
frc.spectrumLib.localization.TagSighting
Record Components:
camera - camera name, for per-camera logging
timestampSeconds - capture time, Timer.getTimestamp() base
tagId - fiducial id
tagField - the tag's centre on the field
robotToCamera - camera mount, robot frame (x forward, y left, z up)
cameraToTag - the tag's centre in the camera frame (x out of the lens, y left, z up)
noiseScale - the camera's std-dev multiplier; 1 for none
public record TagSighting(String camera, double timestampSeconds, int tagId, Translation3d tagField, Transform3d robotToCamera, Translation3d cameraToTag, double noiseScale) extends Record
One AprilTag seen by one camera in one frame: where the tag's centre was, relative to the camera. TagEkf turns it into a bearing and a distance from the camera.

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal.
